liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, and with {{undrawn_facilities@FY2024}} of undrawn committed facilities liquidity stood at {{liquidity@FY2024}}, or {{liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}} of revenue.

Debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, covered {{short_term_debt_cover@FY2024}} by liquidity, and borrowings due within two years of {{borrowings_due_2y@FY2024}} are covered {{liquidity_to_borrowings_due_2y@FY2024}} by liquidity, so near-term maturities are met without new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments turned positive at {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, from {{fcf_after_leases@FY2023}} in FY2023, lifting FCF after leases to debt by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}}.

Customer prepayments rose, with contract liabilities up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}} and advance ticket cover at {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, in line with the peer median.

watch_items.text: Leverage: net leverage rose by {{net_leverage.change@FY2024}} to {{net_leverage@FY2024}} and gross leverage by {{gross_leverage.change@FY2024}} to {{gross_leverage@FY2024}}, both above the peer medians of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2024}} and {{gross_leverage.peer_median@FY2024}}.
Cash generation: FFO to debt was broadly unchanged at {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}}, below the peer median of {{ffo_to_debt.peer_median@FY2024}}, as FFO fell by {{ffo.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo@FY2024}}.

Liquidity: cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue down by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.
Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, so a larger share of liquidity is customers' prepayments.
